description: ERROR LAYER 2c - OCCASIONAL HOWLERS (the tail), tuned separately from the everyday core. The game keeps two populations: a normal kick with random error, and four typed mishits (over-hit, awkward body angle, closed down, ball behind the body) that carry a guaranteed minimum miss. This pack raises how often a typed mishit fires (both roll sites x1.3 - they gate different types, so both are needed), lifts the guaranteed minimum miss on the awkward-angle / behind-body types from 8 to 15 deg so a howler is visibly a howler, and removes the stock exemption that ZEROES sideways error on assisted passes (without this, pass-assist players can never pull or push a normal pass). Ability still suppresses every probability, so elite players mishit far less. All re-aims or a 6-byte branch change; no new code. Byte-identical to entries that ran in-game (slices-scuffs.json A, A2, D; loose-realism-v2.json K-keep). Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/error-howlers.json

patches.name: guaranteed minimum miss on awkward/behind-body mishits 8 -> 15 deg
assisted passes are no longer exempt from sideways error
